description: This file defines a React component for the dashboard header in Apache Superset, including UI elements, state management, and interactions such as editing, saving, and modals.

methods.name: discardChanges
methods.description: Deletes 'edit' parameter from URL to discard unsaved changes.

methods.name: showPropertiesModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the PropertiesModal.

methods.name: hidePropertiesModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the PropertiesModal.

methods.name: showRefreshModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the RefreshIntervalModal.

methods.name: hideRefreshModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the RefreshIntervalModal.

methods.name: showEmbedModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the DashboardEmbedModal.

methods.name: hideEmbedModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the DashboardEmbedModal.

methods.name: showReportModal
methods.description: Sets state to show the ReportModal.

methods.name: hideReportModal
methods.description: Sets state to hide the ReportModal.

methods.name: handleReportDelete
methods.description: Deletes a report and resets currentReportDeleting state.

methods.name: handleOnPropertiesChange
methods.description: Handles updates to dashboard properties and triggers info change actions.

methods.name: handleRefreshChange
methods.description: Updates refresh frequency and edit mode state.

methods.name: handleEnterEditMode
methods.description: Switches dashboard to edit mode, clears history, and resets unsaved changes.
